periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation approximately 45 degrees downward relative to the horizontal snout axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval shape with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Visible tapering and extension towards the lower-anterior region of the face.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow U-shape curvature along the posterior edge of the band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick transverse band covering approximately one-quarter of the dorsal-thoracic length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Clear separation between ear regions by a wide cranial plateau of light-colored fur.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly rounded convex curvature at the superior boundaries of the pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: The non-pigmented fur exhibits a distinct creamy-yellowish tint rather than a high-reflectance white.
